label: Jurassic Park premiered 33 years ago today
note: Spielberg's 1993 blockbuster opened in Australian cinemas on this date — still the gold standard for practical-meets-digital effects.

label: World Donut Day
note: The first Friday of June every year. Originated in 1938 to honour Salvation Army volunteers who served donuts to soldiers in WWII.

label: 1983: Australia wins the America's Cup for the first time
note: Australia II ended a 132-year American winning streak — the longest winning streak in the history of sport.
